name: flip-clock-digits
title: Flip Clock Digits
description: Split-flap style digit transitions: each changing digit folds through a two-panel rotateX with a shadow phase, built on real 3D transforms with backface culling and per-digit stagger.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Industrial
Macrostructure: Rail
Density: Compact
Shape: Sharp
Motion: Mechanical
Typography: Monospace
Color: High Contrast

## Rules

- Value Change: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
